statement: The equation $x=\sqrt{1+x}$ is to be solved by the iteration $x_{n+1}=\sqrt{1+x_{n}}$ with $x_{0}=1$. Find $x_{1}$ and $x_{2}$ to 3 decimal places.
solution:
$$x_{1}=\sqrt{1+1}=\sqrt2\approx1.41421356\approx1.414\quad(\text{3 d.p.}),$$
$$x_{2}=\sqrt{1+x_{1}}=\sqrt{1+1.41421356}=\sqrt{2.41421356}\approx1.55377397\approx1.554\quad(\text{3 d.p.}).$$
So $x_{1}\approx1.414$ and $x_{2}\approx1.554$. (The iteration converges to the positive root of $x^{2}-x-1=0$, namely $\tfrac{1+\sqrt5}{2}\approx1.618$.)
